name: Youth Career Services (WIOA)
org: Santa Barbara County Workforce Development Board, with Goodwill Industries Youth Centers
what_you_do: Get paid work experience at a local business that fits your interests, with a supervisor who mentors you. The program also offers tutoring, college prep, money skills and leadership chances.
who_can_apply: Santa Barbara County residents ages 14 to 24 who are allowed to work in the US and need help to find a job or get into school.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The page does not list a wage.
deadline_text: No deadline. Orientations are held every Tuesday from 4 to 5 p.m. on Zoom.
how_to_apply: Call your nearest Goodwill Youth Center to join a Tuesday Zoom orientation: Santa Barbara 805-845-3926, Santa Maria 805-928-5282, Lompoc 805-736-6700. Or email workforceservices@goodwillvsb.org. The county page also has an interest form.
notes: This is a federal WIOA program, so you have to qualify, and the youth center checks eligibility. Centers are open Monday to Thursday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m. to noon. Santa Barbara center: 302 W Carrillo Street. Paid work under 18 in California needs a work permit.
